name: The Reaper (buffed)
author: Kyhros
description: Avoid the cube portal as the ship at 5.8%. You become mini at 7.7%. Avoid obstacles and normal gameplay as the mini ship until 13.9%, where you must hit the invisible wave portal to fall to the floor as the mini wave. Hold to the ceiling at 15.4%. Drop at 31.5% and go into the portals. Go between the hitboxes at 33.2% twice and fall to the floor afterwards. Stay there until the end.
